contracts_verified: Slice and Drill select one visible owner per placement; endpoint/center owner is preferred when it belongs to the visible groups, and other intersected owners remain for subsequent placements.
A freehand gesture may service multiple owners sequentially; it is not cross-owner atomic.
The 33,333us gate applies to continued service (pressed=false); fresh presses and the explicit Slice release request immediate service through the same one-outstanding-transaction guard.
Save start stores authored recipe and acknowledged terrain erasure. It waits for unresolved edit fences and does not checkpoint moving damage, poses, combustion or inventories.
Freehand and unadmitted Drill release cancels pending intent. Slice release commits one bounded immutable line intent with a two-second deadline.
Input cancellation does not roll back already admitted work; the port tracks authoritative refusal/applied/uncertain outcomes. Applied edits have a separate coherent publication fence.
World replacement retires the old port generation and never replays previous intent into the new scene.
Changing seed or loading a fresh authored scene resets the weathering pass; re-entering the same unchanged SpinBox value does not.
